entryPoints: context menu on empty palette background

protected: standard copy with existing contextual result-copy rules
shortcuts.conflict: keep previous working assignment; tray/menu-bar access remains available if no working assignment

modeTransitions.expand: place quick draft in the first line of a new sheet
modeTransitions.returnToQuick: preserve the sheet and restore the preceding quick draft

autostart.actualOsPermission: respect and report actual system registration/permission; do not assume the requested setting succeeded

appearance.specificFontColorsAndOpacity: Light-sheet appearance accepted in round 33. The complete revised round 34 screens and neutral graphite-black Dark+ palette are accepted; exact adapted tokens are in workspace.json.

localization.initialLocale: system language if its translation is available, otherwise en
localization.missingLocale: English only; do not activate an unavailable local notation dictionary
localization.missingMessage: English source text only for that message
localization.switch: immediate interface update; recognized built-in semantic symbols adapt
localization.unrecognizedRemainder: leave visible and apply ordinary input diagnostics; do not guess a translation
localization.inputNotations: Latin baseline plus only the resolved active interface locale

completion.midTokenTab: replace the whole current identifier, not just the prefix before the caret
completion.functionParentheses: preserve existing parentheses and arguments; add a pair only when absent
fullDescription: F1 for selected suggestion; general help otherwise
completion.insufficientSpace: fewer visible rows with scrolling and stationary input

accessibility.diagnostic: brief, near expression, no input displacement

verificationOutstanding: verification of definition editor and settings states beyond the accepted prototype fixtures
extreme completion edges and scaled layouts
decisionStatus: product and visual choices accepted; remaining items are engineering verification
